almostIncluded.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Rampaging Baloths, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.

feature.name: Put all basic Plains from your library onto the battlefield

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it, searching your library for a basic Plains and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
The Plains enters the battlefield, triggering Emeria Shepherd, returning Sakura-Tribe Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Rampaging Baloths, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.

feature.name: Infinitely large creature until end of turn

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting any creature you control except the creature that has Lightning Greaves attached.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Lightning Greaves's equip ability.
Repeat.

Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Rampaging Baloths, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.

feature.name: Infinite copies of all tokens you control

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Vitu-Ghazi Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{G}{W}, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put one of the Smaug tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}{W}.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may create infinite 3/3 Centaurs and/or copies of any tokens you control instead.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Activate Garruk's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to draw cards equal to the Fractal's power, thus causing you to draw your entire library.

Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
If you do not have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token's ascend ability triggers, causing you to get the city's blessing for the rest of the game.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least eight other permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
